items.text: In intact Arabidopsis seeds given water, adenosine triphosphate rises and oxygen is used within minutes of the wetting, and the mitochondrial matrix's thiols shift toward reduction. Across 412 redox-switched cysteine peptides, the oxidized share falls from 27.1 to 13.0 per cent. Seeds lacking glutathione reductase 2, NADPH-thioredoxin reductase a/b and thioredoxin-o1 respire more, the citric acid cycle's dynamics disturbed, and their germination once aged is strongly impaired.

items.text: At a mouse egg's fertilising, adenosine triphosphate rises with the first calcium transient and again about an hour later, from about 1.9 mM to a peak of 3 mM, and returns to its prior level as the calcium oscillations end. items.text: In single cells of human embryos ahead of implanting, the paternal genome's chromatin is more open than the maternal genome's from the mid-zygote stage to the 4-cell stage, unlike in mice. Genes varying most in DNA methylation and genes varying most in chromatin accessibility are two different sets. With transcription inhibited, 1,797 of 5,155 widely open promoter regions, 35 per cent, close.
